CASTING (Projekt płatny)
Opis: Na świecie wybucha epidemia nieznanej choroby. Samotny naukowiec zamyka się w podziemnym laboratorium, by opracować lek, mogący uratować ludzkość. W czeluściach pustych ciemnych korytarzy mierzy się on z samotnością, uciekającym czasem, przepracowaniem i własnym umysłem, który po latach odosobnienia zaczyna płatać mu figle.

Zdjęcia: Łódź, WYMAGANA DOSTĘPNOŚĆ 21.11

Zapewniamy: Catering, zwrot kosztów dojazdu i nocleg jeśli jest potrzeba 

MĘŻCZYZNA– Zawieszony między kontrolą a chaosem. Analityczny umysł, pod maską profesjonalisty zaczynają wygrywać emocje.

LABORANT– Impulsywny, żyjący w stałym napięciu. Zaciera granicę między życiem prywatnym a pracą.

ZGŁOSZENIA

Prosimy o maila na adres: casting@senema.no

W wiadomości prosimy o dołączenie:

Aktualnego zdjęcia (twarz + sylwetka)

Wizytówkę wideo lub link do portfolio/CV

Numer telefonu do kontaktu

UWAGA, CASTING  

Szukamy dwóch aktorów do reklamy z branży alkoholowej.

ROLE:

1. Mężczyzna 25–35 lat – europejski typ urody, naturalny, charyzmatyczny, z charakterem i poczuciem humoru.
2. Mężczyzna 25–35 lat – europejski typ urody, swobodny, autentyczny, z dobrym wyczuciem komedii.

Zależy nam na naturalnej grze, dobrym timingu i chemii między aktorami. Nie szukamy typowych modeli, ale osób, które potrafią grać subtelną mimiką, gestami i spojrzeniami.

Wymagany swobodny język angielski – nie trzeba być native speakerem.

Ważne: kandydaci muszą mieć ukończone 25 lat najpóźniej w ostatnim dniu zdjęciowym.

Stawka: 16 500 zł
Zgłoszenia do 9.11 (do końca dnia)

Jeśli pasujesz albo znasz kogoś, kto może pasować, zostaw w komentarzu „START STUDIO” + swoje zdjęcie. Odezwiemy się do wybranych osób z dalszymi szczegółami!

#startstudio #agencjaaktorska

Hi all! I'm an actor new to the group, currently looking to connect with filmmakers, directors and creatives and find opportunities in short and feature films.

I work across stage, screen and musical theatre, with a particular interest in period drama, contemporary psychological drama, Shakespeare, comedy and musical theatre.

I'm a physically expressive performer who brings an embodied, emotionally grounded approach to my work. I'm particularly drawn to complex characters, psychologically nuanced performances and stories that explore the human experience.

Would love to connect with others working in film/theatre and hear about any upcoming projects or opportunities. 

I have attached my Spotlight and Headshots below.

https://app.spotlight.com/profile

Thank you 🙏

CASTING CALL: IN HER KEEPING

San Diego, CA | Nonunion psychological horror short

Writer/director: Richard Wilson

Casting three roles for a short film about grief, family guilt and a relationship that becomes increasingly frightening at night.

FILMING: February 2027, across two to three weekends, primarily Saturdays and Sundays with possible Friday evenings. Exact dates and each actor’s commitment are being scheduled. Please send your February weekend conflicts; availability for every weekend is not automatically required.

AUDITIONS: Shortlisted applicants will receive script excerpts and audition instructions. Audition dates and format/location are not yet set. No new self-tape is requested with the initial application.

INTENDED USE: Film festivals, with possible later online or other distribution release. Participation and usage terms will be provided in the written agreement before anyone commits.

ROLES

JESSICA | Woman, playing age 30s | Lead

Grieving, loving and increasingly frightened, Jessica wants to do right by her sister while struggling with guilt she cannot put down. Seeking natural, intimate acting and sustained emotional tension. Includes shared-bed scenes, embraces, strong language, staged physical aggression, a fall, a simulated knife attack and practical blood effects.

NICK | Man, playing age 30s | Lead

Jessica’s boyfriend is warm and supportive by day, unsettling in the nighttime encounters. Seeking affection, vulnerability and quiet menace. Includes shared-bed scenes, embraces, staged physical aggression, simulated neck contact, a fatal injury effect, a fall and sustained body stillness.

JACKIE | Woman, playing age 50s to 60s | Supporting

Runs the group home where Jessica’s sister lives. Calm, compassionate and practical. Seeking a grounded performance with attentive listening and room for silence.

The film addresses bereavement, suicide and family guilt. No nudity or simulated sex is written in the current script. Physical scenes require advance discussion and separately planned choreography. No physical violence is requested in auditions.

COMPENSATION: No upfront pay. Selected actors will be offered actual fractional copyright coownership under a written collaboration agreement. Individual percentages will be agreed before participation. Ownership includes voting rights and a share of Distributable Cash, subject to the agreement’s administration and approval rules. Income and final-cut approval are not guaranteed.

Under the proposed model, the first $500 of lifetime project receipts goes to Richard Wilson. Permitted deductions, reimbursement of documented festival submission advances, a 10% administration charge, other documented project costs and reasonable reserves precede owner distributions. Individual allocations under $100 may carry forward. Full terms will be supplied before anyone commits.

TO APPLY: Email rich@rwvinc.com with the subject “In Her Keeping Casting: [Role]”. Include your name, phone number, general location, recent headshot or clear photo, résumé and reel if available, union status, and February weekend conflicts. For Fridays, include earliest arrival and latest departure times. A professional reel is not required. Send video links rather than large attachments.

Playing ages describe the characters; please do not send your date of birth.

AUDITIONS FOR DE KOVEN'S LIGHT OPERA: ROBIN HOOD

Music by Reginald De Koven - Libretto by Harry B. Smith

Auditions are held at Avon Free Public Library - Board Room on 2nd Floor at 281 Country Club Road, Avon, Connecticut 06001. Audition: Nov 21st [3:00 pm - 5:00 pm] & Nov 24th [6:00 PM - 8:00 PM] Please prepare 32 measures, please provide your own backing 

Rehearsals: 

Rehearsals: Mondays and Wednesdays nights starting Jan 18th [5pm to 8pm]

Tech: March 15-17. [5pm - 8pm]

Performances: March 19 (7pm) & 20 (7pm) at The Canton Community Baptist Church - 125 Dowd Ave, Canton, CT 06019

Volunteer, Non Union, No Travel or Board Provided

[https://forms.gle/fCEtvFAtrtTHAyAc6](https://forms.gle/fCEtvFAtrtTHAyAc6?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgVicmlkETFoNHgwMEQ4eTExRkNscVRSc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABH-MGU0DmGHeFQ3Ub7LG9Vamy1555kYKnDrGCPYPpz6c62emI0nTESNxp8WH4_aem_6BOG4zlGkhqVz97drZ2w4A)

Robert, Earl of Huntington, wins the admiration of the outlaws by his marksmanship, whilst the Sheriff of Nottingham repudiates his claims to the Earldom and declares Guy of Gisborne the real heir. Robert joins the outlaws and becomes the celebrated Robin Hood. Lady Marian has been commanded by the King to wed the Earl of Huntington and comes in disguise to see what sort of man he may be. With Robert she is well pleased, and they plight their troth, but when the wily Sheriff substitutes Guy as the Earl, Lady Marian conceals the King’s decrees, commanding her to marry him.

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS

FINAL OPEN CASTING CALL

DIVA AIRWAYS: THE RISE & FALL

A Three-Act Comedy-Drama | World Premiere — Chicago, 2027

NON-UNION ACTORS ONLY | PAID ROLES

FlightTime Productions is seeking talented and dedicated performers for its upcoming world-premiere production of Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall, written and directed by Matthew Stevens.

Join us for this exciting original comedy-drama filled with laughter, friendship, family, workplace rivalries, and unexpected turbulence!

OPEN AUDITION INFORMATION

Monday, November 9, 2026

11:00 AM – 4:00 PM

West Loop Branch Library — Meeting Room

122 N. Aberdeen Street

Chicago, IL 60607

NO APPOINTMENT NECESSARY!

Audition check-in closes promptly at 4:00 PM.

AVAILABLE ROLES

All roles offer an $800 performance stipend.

* COLIN (16+) — Alexa’s caring younger brother, struggling with complicated family relationships.

* TIFFANY BELMONT (16+) — Miss Brooks’ stylish, ambitious, outspoken, and hilariously unpredictable assistant.

* BROOKLYN (16+) — The rival airline CEO’s daughter, whose loyalty begins to shift toward Diva Airways.

* SABRINA (25+) — A hardworking, loyal airline lounge manager confronting the company’s financial challenges.

AUDITION REQUIREMENTS

Please prepare a 1–2 minute comedic or dramatic monologue and bring a current headshot and acting résumé. Performers will also participate in group improvisation activities.

CALLBACKS — BY INVITATION ONLY

Friday, November 13, 2026 | 10:00 AM

Pullman Branch Library

11001 S. Indiana Avenue

Chicago, IL 60628

REHEARSALS & PERFORMANCES

Rehearsals Begin: January 10, 2027

Technical Rehearsals: April 4–7, 2027

Performance Engagement: April 8 – May 30, 2027

QUESTIONS & CASTING INQUIRIES

divaairwaysstage@gmail.com

Please note: West Loop Branch Library is not affiliated with or a sponsor of this production.

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS

Where the drama is first class, the comedy is nonstop, and the turbulence is guaranteed!

Still looking to fill a couple of roles at each venue:

**CASTING CALL - CHRISTMAS 2026 for **[TaleGate Theatre Productions Ltd](https://www.facebook.com/groups/5076437733/user/100060452334767/?__cft__[0]=AZhsjWQrVz9M6M5QSe7jMeiQPKDirasSZYLGnM37S5nU_k5ghDSLOdN5ciO-xEIfmAgAe0mabtcoVHPdKOdHGTlwM_nQ_zKpj_jQrDTD7rvprelao7VbeFemR9AbTVerRq-0GfBXeSuvq_86nXUq&__tn__=-]K-R)

TaleGate Theatre is looking for talented performers to join us for two exciting Christmas experiences this festive season. For over 15 years we have been producing pantomimes and immersive experiences across the UK. We’re looking for talented performers to join us this Christmas and help bring our festive productions to life for audiences and families.

Accommodation can be provided for both contracts making the roles suitable for performers across the UK to apply to.

**CHRONICLES OF CHRISTMAS**
Location: B98 9DB

Seeking performers to create unique characters, guide audiences through immersive environments and respond creatively to audience interaction. Whilst a framework and story will be provided, the role relies heavily on improvisation and your ability to bring the world to life beyond a fixed script.
Rehearsals- 13th & 14th Nov

Run- 28th & 29th Nov, 5th & 6th Dec, 12th & 13th Dec, 18th-24th Dec
Working hours: 9am–5pm, with a 30-minute break
Fee: £1,875 buyout
Accommodation can be provided for performers who do not live locally.

**CHRISTMAS WITH THE CLAUSES**
Location: OX7 5QH

We’re looking for performers to bring our festive characters to life through interactive storytelling, character encounters and improvisation. The role is ideal for performers who enjoy engaging with children and families and creating a fun, welcoming Christmas experience.

Rehearsal -20th Nov

Run- 21st & 22nd Nov, 28th & 29th Nov, 5th & 6th Dec, 10th-13th Dec, 16th-24th Dec
Working hours: 9am–7pm, with a 30-minute break and a 15-minute break
Fee: £2,160 buyout
Accommodation can be provided for performers who do not live locally.

**PLEASE NOTE:** Performers must be available for all rehearsal and performance dates for their chosen production. We are accepting applications from across the UK.

**HOW TO APPLY**

To be considered, please email **admin@talegatetheatre.co.uk** with a short covering note outlining your relevant experience, alongside your CV and showreel. We’re casting from showreels for these roles, so please make sure you include one with your application.

Thank you and please share with any performers who might be interested!

topComments.text: If you have emailed us re this opportunity and use a hotmail or live email address we cannot reply to you as they're currently bouncing back across several servers (this isn't unique to us!) - we can receive your emails so please do include a phone number so we can text you in response!

🎬 – WSPÓŁCZESNY SERIAL (WARSZAWA) 🎥
12.11 CZWARTEK 
🏋️‍♂️ POSZUKUJEMY STATYSTÓW: SENIORÓW ORAZ OPIEKUNÓW (25-40 LAT) 🧑‍⚕️

Do sceny grupowej kręconej na plenerowej siłowni ,poszukujemy osób do dwóch różnych ról! Szukamy ludzi naturalnych, swobodnych przed kamerą i pełnych pozytywnej energii.

🗓️ TERMIN NA PLANIE:
* 12 LISTOPADA 2026 (czwartek) –
* Lokacja: Plenerowa siłownia przy Arkadii

KOGO POSZUKUJEMY? (Zgłoszenia zostaną przydzielone do odpowiedniej grupy na podstawie wieku):

1️⃣ GRUPA A – SENIORZY ĆWICZĄCY
* Profil: Osoby w wieku emerytalnym o ciekawych, charakterystycznych twarzach. 
* Wymagania: Dobra sprawność fizyczna, pozwalająca na wiarygodne wykonywanie prostych ćwiczeń i aerobiku przed kamerą. Bez przerysowywania starości czy niedołężności – stawiamy na autentyczność i radość z ruchu!

2️⃣ GRUPA B– OPIEKUNOWIE / TERAPEUCI
* Profil: Kobiety i mężczyźni w wieku 25–40 lat.
* Wymagania: Sprawność fizyczna i otwartość – rola polega na prowadzeniu i animowaniu zajęć ruchowych dla seniorów.

💸Wynagrodzenie: 110 zł za udział w projekcie.

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?
Wyślij zgłoszenie mailowe na adres: paulina@sceneria.com.pl
W tytule wiadomości koniecznie wpisz: – SIŁOWNIA

W treści wiadomości podaj:
1. Imię i nazwisko
2. Wiek
3. Numer telefonu do kontaktu
4. Aktualne zdjęcia (wyraźne ujęcie twarzy oraz zdjęcie przedstawiające całą sylwetkę)

𝗖𝗮𝗻 𝗜 𝗷𝗼𝗶𝗻 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗺𝗮𝘀𝘀𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗻𝗼 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲?
​
Yes — and many of our students are career changers.
​
They come from very different backgrounds: tech, yoga, dance, hospitality, office jobs, creative work. Some already work with the body, others are starting completely from scratch.
​
That mix is part of the training. You don’t need to arrive already knowing how to massage. You learn the foundations step by step.
​
So if massage is something you’re considering as a new professional direction, lack of previous experience is not a barrier.
​
𝗡𝗲𝘅𝘁 𝗔𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗺𝘆 & 𝗪𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗠𝗮𝘀𝘀𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 
Start: January 23
4 places left
​

Let's welcome our new members!
We're thrilled to have you join our vibrant community dedicated to exploring career opportunities . Whether you're embarking on a new job search, seeking career advice, or looking to connect with professionals in your field, you've come to the right place.

As a new member, you're now part of a supportive network of individuals who share a common goal: navigating the dynamic job markets . Here, you'll find valuable resources, job postings from top companies, insightful discussions, and opportunities to expand your professional network.

Feel free to ask questions – our community is here to help you every step of the way. Whether you're a recent graduate, an experienced professional, or someone exploring new career paths, your unique perspectives and experiences enrich our group.Thank you for your time, best regards.        أهلاً بكم في المجموعة!

دعونا نرحب بأعضائنا الجدد!
يسعدنا انضمامكم إلى مجتمعنا الحيوي المخصص لاستكشاف الفرص المهنية. وسواء كنتم بصدد البحث عن وظيفة جديدة، أو تسعون للحصول على مشورة مهنية، أو تتطلعون للتواصل مع محترفين في مجالكم، فقد وصلتم إلى المكان الصحيح.

بصفتكم أعضاءً جدداً، أصبحتم الآن جزءاً من شبكة داعمة تضم أفراداً يجمعهم هدف مشترك: التعامل بفعالية مع أسواق العمل المتغيرة. ستجدون هنا موارد قيمة، وإعلانات وظائف من كبرى الشركات، ونقاشات ثرية، وفرصاً لتوسيع شبكة علاقاتكم المهنية.

لا تترددوا في طرح الأسئلة؛ فمجتمعنا هنا لدعمكم في كل خطوة. وسواء كنتم خريجين جدداً، أو محترفين ذوي خبرة، أو تسعون لاستكشاف مسارات مهنية جديدة، فإن وجهات نظركم وخبراتكم الفريدة تُثري مجموعتنا. شكراً لكم على وقتكم، مع أطيب      التحيات.                 @followers                                                     Bienvenue dans le groupe !

Souhaitons la bienvenue à nos nouveaux membres !
Nous sommes ravis de vous voir rejoindre notre communauté dynamique, dédiée à l'exploration d'opportunités de carrière. Que vous entamiez une recherche d'emploi, que vous cherchiez des conseils professionnels ou que vous souhaitiez entrer en contact avec des experts de votre secteur, vous êtes au bon endroit.

En tant que nouveau membre, vous intégrez un réseau bienveillant de personnes partageant un objectif commun : évoluer sur un marché de l'emploi en constante mutation. Vous y trouverez des ressources précieuses, des offres d'emploi d'entreprises de premier plan, des échanges enrichissants ainsi que des occasions d'élargir votre réseau professionnel.

N'hésitez pas à poser des questions : notre communauté est là pour vous accompagner à chaque étape. Que vous soyez jeune diplômé, professionnel expérimenté ou en pleine reconversion, vos perspectives et expériences uniques enrichissent notre groupe. Merci de votre attention et bien cordialement.@seguidores                                                     ¡Bienvenidos al grupo!

¡Demos la bienvenida a nuestros nuevos miembros!
Nos entusiasma que se unan a nuestra dinámica comunidad dedicada a explorar oportunidades laborales. Ya sea que estén iniciando una nueva búsqueda de empleo, buscando asesoramiento profesional o deseando conectar con colegas de su sector, han llegado al lugar indicado.

Como nuevos miembros, ahora forman parte de una red de apoyo compuesta por personas que comparten un objetivo común: desenvolverse con éxito en el dinámico mercado laboral. Aquí encontrarán recursos valiosos, ofertas de empleo de empresas destacadas, debates enriquecedores y oportunidades para ampliar su red de contactos profesionales.

No duden en hacer preguntas; nuestra comunidad está aquí para ayudarles en cada etapa del camino. Tanto si son recién graduados como profesionales con experiencia o personas que exploran nuevas trayectorias laborales, sus perspectivas y experiencias únicas enriquecen nuestro grupo. Gracias por su tiempo y un cordial saludo.@Follower                                                     Willkommen in der Gruppe!

Lasst uns unsere neuen Mitglieder willkommen heißen!
Wir freuen uns sehr, dass ihr Teil unserer lebendigen Community seid, die sich der Erkundung von Karrieremöglichkeiten widmet. Egal, ob ihr gerade auf Jobsuche seid, Karriereberatung sucht oder euch mit Fachleuten aus eurem Bereich vernetzen möchtet – hier seid ihr genau richtig.

Als neues Mitglied gehört ihr nun zu einem unterstützenden Netzwerk von Menschen, die ein gemeinsames Ziel verfolgen: sich auf den dynamischen Arbeitsmärkten zu orientieren. Hier findet ihr wertvolle Ressourcen, Stellenangebote von Top-Unternehmen, aufschlussreiche Diskussionen und Gelegenheiten, euer berufliches Netzwerk zu erweitern.

Scheut euch nicht, Fragen zu stellen – unsere Community steht euch bei jedem Schritt zur Seite. Ob ihr Berufseinsteiger oder erfahrene Fachkräfte seid oder neue Karrierewege erkundet: Eure einzigartigen Perspektiven und Erfahrungen bereichern unsere Gruppe. Vielen Dank für eure Zeit und herzliche Grüße.

**EVENT BRAND AMBASSADORS/MODELS (female/male) @ SANTA BARBARA**

Join Sky Hostess for a private event near Riviera in Santa Barbara!

**November 17 (location A)**
Location 1: 7:00 AM–3:30 PM
Location 2: 6:30 PM–11:30 PM

**November 18**
Location 2: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM

Tasks include welcoming guests, opening car doors, offering assistance, handing out gifts, and providing directions.

• $30 per hour
• Payment within 72 hours after the event
• Free parking
• Crew catering for longer shifts

We’re looking for friendly, polished professionals with fluent English and guest-facing experience.
Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S.

Apply at www.sky-hostess.com/join-us
In your message, include **“Santa Barbara November 2026”** and your availability.

items.text:
LOOKING FOR BACKGROUND
Hello everyone! 

Im Alice, the producer of Closing Costs, one of the finals  from Vancouver Film School. 

We are currently looking for male background actors for some of the shootings in the office! 

This offer is volunteer, since we are a low budget production. There will be crafty in site. 

The background has a big part on our movie since we have plans to choreograph a big scene because we want to represent a lack of humanity by having every single person making the same movements: typing, calling, stretching, etc.

If you’re interested please send us an email to sales.team.six.productions@gmail.com* with your headshot and resume! 

Thank you!

items.text:
Casting call: You Like It Here
VFS student short film | Psychological horror

Hi everyone! We’re looking for four actors for You Like It Here.

On Sabrina’s first night in Norway, unsettling events unfold as her overprotective mother’s presence becomes increasingly suspicious.

Filming dates & location
Nov 28 -Nov 29, Greater Vancouver Area (specific locations TBC)

Compensation
Unpaid. Craft service provided.

Union status: Non Union

Roles (playing ages)
* Sabrina: Female, 18–25, any ethnicity
* Olivia: Female, 40–50, any ethnicity
* Ingrid: Female, 40–65, Scandinavian
* Erik: Male, 40–65, Scandinavian

The attached casting breakdowns have more about each character.

To apply
Email your headshot, resume and demo reel to farfromhomep@gmail.com by November 18, 2026. Please include the role you’re applying for.
Selected applicants will receive the script and self-tape instructions by email. Shortlisted actors will then be invited to an in-person callback.

Thanks for taking a look! Please pass this along to anyone who might be interested.

items.text:
🎬 **CASTING DO TELEDYSKU RAPOWEGO | Bielsko-Biała, 12.11 lub 13.11 (któryś z tych dni - jeden dzień zdjęciowy)**

**POSZUKUJĘ:**

**STATYŚCI, 18-30 lat: 100 zł gotówką od razu po planie**
Energia, żywioł, blokowe klimaty. Domówka rodem z blokowiska albo scena przy starym aucie pod blokiem.

Tytuł maila: **STATYŚCI KLIP 12.11**-**13.11**

**STATYŚCI, 30–50 lat: 100 zł netto gotówką od razu po planie**
Imieniny u szalonej ciotki: schludnie przy stole, ale z luzem.
Tytuł maila: **STATYŚCI URODZINY CIOTKI 12.11-13.11**

**EPIZODYŚCI, 40–60 lat: 500 zł netto płatne po planie**
Charyzmatyczni szaleni wujkowie rodem z PRL na imieninach u ciotki.
Tytuł maila: **EPIZODYSTA KLIP 12.11-13.11**

**W zgłoszeniu:** imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, zdjęcie twarzy i sylwetki bez filtrów. Epizodyści dodatkowo link do wizytówki na YouTube.

📩 karina.szymocha@gmail.com
⏰ Na zgłoszenia czekam do jutra (05.11), do 18:00

topComments.text: Bardzo proszę: CZYTAJCIE UWAŻNIE. Zdjęcia odbywają się w BIELSKO-BIAŁEJ. Nie zgłaszajcie się będąc w Warszawie. Szkoda mojego i Waszego czasu. Dzięki!

Data: 26.11 i 27.11

Stawka: 1200 zł netto za 2 dni  

-Norbert Białkowski (34) – trener boksu i kibol, wysportowany, cwaniakowaty, szorstki w obyciu.

-Seba (22) – narkoman, przeciętny wygląd, krótkie włosy, dość komunikatywny.

2.Artur (27) – pracownik lakierni samochodowej. Dobrze zbudowany, postawny, krótkie włosy. Konkretny, chętnie rozmawia z policją.
Data: 11 listopada

3.Stróż (60) – stróż pracujący na złomowisku. Ciekawski, interesuje się wszystkim dookoła.

CASTING CALL
The Star is an upcoming comedy-drama short film exploring fame, nostalgia, love and regret.

Set between the colourful music scene of 1980s Britain and the present day, the film follows an ageing popstar whose glory days are long behind him. When an unexpected visitor arrives with a connection to his past, he is forced to confront the memories, relationships and choices he has spent years avoiding.

Blending humour with heartfelt moments, The Star explores what happens when the world moves on, but you don't.

Please contact: thestarshortfilm@gmail.com - if interested:)

Film Speed-Friending: Quick one-to-one chats with fun film questions. 🎬
Moved to Copenhagen recently, or just want to meet new people and make friends? Film Speed-Friending is one of the easiest way to do it.

How it works:

Have one-to-one conversation with someone new

Pick a film question card, like “What’s your favourite movie?” or “Which film sequel was better than the original?”

Chat for a few minutes, then meet the next person

By the end of the event you’ll have met everyone in the room and maybe found some new friends!

Love films? Want to meet new people? This event is for you!

Join Film Society Denmark for an evening of film trivia, charades and a lot of laughs at Urban House Copenhagen!

Come with friends or come solo. Everyone gets a chance to be part of a team, so it’s one of the easiest ways to meet fellow film lovers in Copenhagen and make friends!

What’s in store:
Film trivia: classics, blockbusters, world cinema
Movie charades: act or guess the right movie name
🏆 Prizes for the winning team, plus a special award for the best charades performance

Spots are limited, so book your ticket early. See you there! 🍿

AUDITION PÅ MUSICALSENSATION! 🎭
Der er nu endelig åbnet for auditiontilmeldinger til Nyborg Voldspils næste store sommermusical under åben himmel: ”WE WILL ROCK YOU”, fyldt med 28 af de største hits fra det legendariske rockband Queen! Audition finder sted lørdag/søndag d. 21.-22. november 2026 i Nyborg. Tilmeld dig nu og bliv en del af den første udendørsopsætning på Fyn af den verdensberømte musical hos Danmarks ældste friluftsteater!

DER SØGES TIL FORESTILLINGEN:
30-40 skuespillere, sangere og dansere. Der er i forestillingen 7 solistroller og derudover en lang række bi- og ensembleroller med og uden replikker. Alle køn og aldre fra 15 år og op er velkomne til audition, uanset erfaring og baggrund. Forestillingen opføres i sommeren 2027 fra d. 16. juli til d. 7. august. Du kan læse alt om audition og tilmelding på Nyborg Voldspils hjemmeside, hvor man allerede også kan købe billetter til forestillingen: nyborgvoldspil.dk

ANGÅENDE ENSEMBLE, DANS OG KOR:
Ud over solist- og birollerne medvirker ensemblet løbende gennem forestillingen og har flere funktioner undervejs i både sange og scener (enkelte har også replikker). Ønsker man at gå til audition som danser uden at skulle synge eller have replikker, er dette også muligt. Selv om forestillingen hovedsageligt byder på rockmusik, er dansere af alle typer/genrer velkomne til audition, uanset erfaring. Går man til audition inden for sang og bliver udtaget til koret, synger man desuden med på mange af de 28 numre i forestillingen ud over at indgå i scener og koreografier.

ANGÅENDE ROLLER:
Du kan læse alt om de individuelle solistroller og biroller, samt hvad man skal forberede til audition, på Nyborg Voldspils hjemmeside her: nyborgvoldspil.dk

VI SES TIL AUDITION!
Vi glæder os til at se mange skønne auditiondeltagere af alle typer og aldre fra 15 år og op d. 21.-22. november. Tilmeld dig nu via følgende link og gå ikke glip af chancen for at få en uforglemmelig sommer med Nyborg Voldspils brag af en opsætning af ”We Will Rock You”: nyborgvoldspil.dk

Nyborg Voldspil præsenterer:
”WE WILL ROCK YOU”
16. juli – 7. august 2027
Instruktør: Rasmus Mansachs
Sanginstruktør/korleder: Johnny Jørgensen
Koreograf: Fie Alberte Damgaard-Lauritsen
Scenograf: Louise Dencker Rasmussen
Kostumier: Jannie Lindhard Pedersen
Orkesterleder: Tuomas Korhonen
Billetsalg og auditiontilmelding: nyborgvoldspil.dk

🎬 CURRENTLY CASTING & RECRUITING CREW

"9 HATS" is an independent urban crime drama/thriller about Malik, a talented young man with dreams of becoming an engineer who is forced to make difficult choices when financial pressure, family responsibilities, and the streets begin pulling him in opposite directions.

We are currently looking for actors and behind-the-scenes crew who are interested in being part of an independent feature film production.

Target Filming: December 2026 / January 2027
Location: New Jersey / surrounding area: Low-budget independent production

Just looking for a chance to make both of us BIG ✨‼️

Compensation: Unpaid/volunteer opportunity
What We Provide: Meals/refreshments during production, production experience, screen credit, footage/materials when applicable, and an opportunity to be part of a feature-length film. 

This is a passion project being built by an independent filmmaker looking to create a serious, gritty, cinematic urban film with a dedicated team.

If you're passionate about filmmaking, acting, cinematography, lighting, sound, directing, production, makeup, wardrobe, or other areas of film production, we would love to hear from you.

Contact: holduptvfilms@gmail.com

🎬 CASTING CALL — LITTLE-PERSON ACTOR WANTED
📍 San Antonio, Texas

I’m casting for an original independent comedy series blending chaotic humor, indie storytelling, and heartfelt moments.

ROLE: FEMALE GUEST CHARACTER — ONE EPISODE

Looking for a little-person actress who can fully embody a character, has strong comedic timing, and can bring a unique personality to the screen.

The character is an ex-girlfriend who brings unexpected energy, tension, and comedy into the story. We’re looking for someone who can make the audience laugh while still making the character feel real.

🎭 One-episode guest appearance

💰 Compensation: Up to $100

📍 San Antonio, TX

📅 Filming date to be determined

Acting experience is a plus. Please Email me a headshot, a short introduction, and any acting clips or reels you have @ jeunevela@gmail.com

Independent production. More details about the character and script will be shared with interested performers.

Please share with anyone who might be a fit! 🎥

items.text:
**CASTING CALL | SINGERS & DANCERS | LOS ANGELES**

Bethesda Repertory Theatre is seeking singers and/or dancers of all backgrounds, styles, and genres for our upcoming holiday production of *An Evening With Company*.

Now in its third consecutive year, this groundbreaking, devised musical celebration brings together a diverse ensemble of artists for an unforgettable evening of music, storytelling, and holiday spirit at Stomping Ground LA. We're looking for passionate and collaborative performers who bring their own unique stories to the stage. Whether your background is musical theatre, jazz, pop, classical, contemporary, or something entirely different, we want to see what you do.

SUBMISSIONS

Please email the following to our Resident Casting Director, Shelby Mumford, at [shelby@bethesdarep.com](mailto:shelby@bethesdarep.com):
* A recent 1–2 minute self-tape or video showcasing your singing and/or dancing.
* Headshot and Résumé
* Your availability for in-person callbacks on **[Monday evening](x-apple-data-detectors://embedded-result/947)****, October 26**, in Glendale.

SUBMISSION DEADLINE: End of Day **Friday, October 23**

PRODUCTION SCHEDULE

Rehearsals | Glendale

Monday, Tuesday, & Thursday Evenings beginning in November

Tech & Performances | Stomping Ground LA
* [Tuesday, Dec 15](x-apple-data-detectors://embedded-result/1186): Tech & Dress | [9:30 AM–6 PM](x-apple-data-detectors://embedded-result/1218)
* [Wednesday, Dec 16](x-apple-data-detectors://embedded-result/1231): Dress & Preview Performance | [4–11 PM](x-apple-data-detectors://embedded-result/1280)
* [Thursday, Dec 17](x-apple-data-detectors://embedded-result/1288): Gala Performance | [4–11 PM](x-apple-data-detectors://embedded-result/1325)

VOLUNTEER PARTICIPATION

As a growing nonprofit, we unfortunately cannot offer monetary compensation to our Performers for this production. We deeply value the time, talent, and commitment of every artist who contributes to our work, and providing meaningful compensation remains an important goal as Bethesda continues to grow. We understand that an unpaid opportunity may not be feasible for everyone and sincerely appreciate your consideration.

Join us as we continue building a joyful holiday tradition that celebrates the extraordinary talent and creativity of our Los Angeles artistic community.

SUBMIT BY OCTOBER 23: [shelby@bethesdarep.com](mailto:shelby@bethesdarep.com)

Learn more about Bethesda at BethesdaRep.com.

Please share with your fellow singers, dancers, and performers!

Stagebugz Theatre is seeking performers and groups of all kinds for our winter variety show on December 3rd! 

For the actors in the group: scenes, comedy routines, strong monologues, improv performances are all welcome! 

Auditions are November 15th at Columbine Library, or via self-tape. Sign up at this link: https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0E4CADAF22A7F5C52-65823774-tricks#/ 

Or email stagebugztheatre@gmail.com for self tape instructions.

This is a volunteer opportunity; however all performers are invited to a post-show reception with lots of food and prizes!

Stagebugz Theatre is a 501(c)3 non-profit dedicated to making arts education more accessible to youth in our community. To learn more about us, visit www.stagebugztheatre.com/

We hope to see you there!

*No part of this post or graphic was created using AI. I can't figure out how to remove the flag from Facebook but want to be clear that Stagebugz does not condone the use of AI in theatrical spaces :)

Louisiana mom here 💛 I have four littles, and my oldest (7) has booked commercials — Chuck E. Cheese, Hardee's, a few more — and almost all of it came from ME submitting him myself before he ever had an agent.

I'm curious about the other moms doing it this way: if you're finding legit commercial bookings for your kids WITHOUT an agent, where are you finding them?

Also — if you hear of Louisiana auditions that fit little ones (mine are 7, 5, 3, and 1), I'm always looking. Happy to share what's worked for us too. 👍🏽

🎭✨ WHAT A FANTASTIC SATURDAY AT ACT!✨🎭

We had another wonderful day at the Academy of Creative Theatre yesterday, filled with creativity, laughter, learning and a little bit of theatrical magic! ❤️

This week, we stepped into the wonderful world of MARY POPPINS!☂️and the Little Mermaid with our Wee Stars 🧜‍♀️ ✨

Our students explored the much-loved themes through singing, dancing, acting and performance, bringing their creativity and imagination to life.

🏆 We also awarded our Lamda Acting students with their results. 
🌟A huge well done to all our exam students.

📸🌟 Here's a little look at some of the fun, hard work and fantastic moments from yesterday's classes!

We love seeing our students grow in confidence, develop their skills, build friendships and shine brighter every week. We are so proud of everything they achieve!

And there's certainly no shortage of excitement at ACT, with lots of fantastic festive performances and opportunities coming up!

🎄 UPCOMING EVENTS & PERFORMANCES

Our young performers are getting ready to take their talents out into the community!

💚 Festive Singing for Chest Heart & Stroke Scotland – Late-Night Shopping.

🎤 The Press and Journal Concert
🎟️ Tickets available here:
https://www.facebook.com/share/p/18VpEeih8d/?mibextid=wwXIfr

🏔️ Festive Carolling at Cairngorm Mountain Resort

🎄 Holiday Singing at Simpsons

🎅 Wee Stars Mini Showcase – A special opportunity for our youngest performers to shine for their parents!

🌟 LOOKING AHEAD TO 2027!

We're already busy planning an exciting year ahead, including our next spectacular production:

🚗💨 CHITTY CHITTY BANG BANG JR!
📍 Eden Court Theatre and Cinema

An unforgettable theatrical adventure filled with music, magic and wonderful opportunities for our young performers to take to the stage! 🎭✨

💛 TRY ACT – TWO-WEEK TRIALS AVAILABLE!

Looking for something creative, confidence-building and fun for your child? We'd love to welcome you!

🌟 CLASSES AVAILABLE

🎭 ACADEMY WORKSHOPS (Ages 7–18)
⏰ 10:30am–1:30pm
💛 Two-week trial: £50

⭐ WEE STARS (Ages 4–6)
⏰ 9:30am–10:30am OR 2:00pm–3:00pm
💛 Two-week trial: £20

🎓 SKILLS & EXAM CLASSES (Ages 8–18)
💛 £20 trial per class

💃 Stageschool Jazz – 9:30am–10:30am

🎭 Acting & Performance – 2:00pm–3:00pm

🎤 Musical Theatre – 3:00pm–4:00pm

Whether your child loves singing, dancing, acting or simply wants to try something new, ACT is the place to discover their potential!

📩 READY TO JOIN THE ACT FAMILY?

Book your child's two-week trial using our online registration form:

🔗 https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScmSDC596Tt_VWc4E1VBT-cdDb67fuM_v9n1VWfn3Ldy3TPFw/viewform?usp=header

❤️ ANOTHER SATURDAY FULL OF ACT MAGIC!

Building confidence, creating opportunities and inspiring young performers.

We can't wait to do it all again next week! 🎭✨

My name is Tamer a photographer based in Berlin and I’m currently looking to connect with other photographers, model agencies and creative art teams here in Berlin 

My work focuses in street photography, still photography, urban environment, landscape photography and street portraits with a strong focus on catching emotions and show them in an organic artistic way which define my photography style. 
I shoot with both analog and digital cameras
I’m especially interested in joining a team where I can shoot regularly and work with models or artists
I am also interested in doing photo walks here in Berlin with other photographers
I would love to help other people who would like to start learning more about photography in general and encourage them to go slowly into the world of photography
If you know any studio or agency or photographer or production company looking for a photographer, I’d love to hear from you guys
Here is my instagram if you would like to check my work

**Casting a young (14-18) hispanic actress **to play ‘Young Sierra’ in Level Up, a Project DU F.I.L.M. production and an episode of the ‘Womanhood’ series.

**Logline:** When a self-doubting female gamer with an invisible disability, is called upon for a game design instructor teaching demo, she must defeat the demons in her mind to prove her worth.

**Character Description:**

**Young Sierra [Female] [Hispanic] [Dark Brown Hair] [Brown Eyes] [Age 14-18]**

Young Sierra has a secret: she loves playing games. It might not seem like a big secret to many, but she’s learned not to tell anyone. All the adversity she’s faced in the gaming space led to her creating a new gamer tag, ‘Cyrus’, so no boys will bully her for being a girl gamer. Make no mistake, she’ll never let anyone take gaming away from her and the bullying has only made her more determined to make an impact on the gaming space when she grows up.

**Compensation:** Actors will be compensated. Minor roles: $50/day. Needed for 1 day. Actors will also receive film credit, meals and crafty on set, footage for demo reels, and a digital copy of the final film.

**Union Status:** Non-Union

**Shooting Information:** Filming in the University of Denver and surrounding neighborhood during December 13-15.

**Audition Information:** Please send your headshot and resume to *levelupproduction2026@gmail.com*. You will receive a side and more information after.

topComments.text: Hi just confirming you’re looking for darker Hispanic skin and hair, rather than light skinned??

items.text:
CASTING CALL 📞
But read this first 

🚨 IS HOLLYWOOD KILLING ITS OWN INDUSTRY BY REFUSING TO CHANGE?

Let's have an honest conversation about the entertainment industry.

For decades, actors have been told to get an agent, find the right connections, get in the right room, know the right people, and hope someone gives them a chance.

How many incredibly talented actors have been overlooked because they didn't have the connections?

How many opportunities have been limited by geography, representation, industry politics, or outdated casting practices?

And now, when someone comes along and tries to do something DIFFERENT, what happens?

Some established casting companies are rejecting the process. They question it. They resist it.

But here's my question:

Are we protecting the integrity of the industry, or protecting the way things have always been done?

The entertainment industry is changing. Technology is changing. Audiences are changing. Independent filmmakers are finding new ways to create, finance, distribute, and promote projects.

So why shouldn't casting evolve, too?

🎬 ENTER GRATWICK AND THE CASTING CALL.

Gratwick is challenging traditional casting with an innovative approach to finding talent for its feature film Just Drive.

Instead of requiring actors to travel across the country just to get in front of someone, they're opening the door to actors everywhere.

Here's why I think actors should pay attention:

🔥 1. ACCESS WITHOUT GEOGRAPHICAL BARRIERS

You can submit from anywhere in the United States. You don't have to live in Los Angeles or New York to get noticed.

🔥 2. YOU'RE BEING EVALUATED ON YOUR CRAFT

The live auditions feature a three-person industry panel, including the director, producer, and casting director. Performances are evaluated across specific acting categories—not simply how many followers you have.

🔥 3. YOU GET PAID FOR YOUR LIVE AUDITION

Selected actors receive $25 for their livestreamed audition segment.

🔥 4. REAL OPPORTUNITIES, NOT JUST ANOTHER AUDITION

The lead female role of Sasha and supporting male role of Jeremy are currently being cast for Just Drive.

If selected and cast, actors can become part of The Set, an interactive live production series.

The announced compensation includes:

- $500 per day for participation in The Set livestream.

- $1,000 per day for film production.

- Backend benefits.

- Housing, transportation, board, and per diem for cast members traveling to Los Angeles.

🔥 5. YOU BUILD VISIBILITY WHILE PURSUING YOUR CAREER

Even if you aren't selected for Sasha or Jeremy, your audition experience could put you in front of filmmakers and an audience who might discover you for something else.

And here's something I really want actors to think about:

What if the opportunity you've been waiting for doesn't look like the opportunity you've been taught to expect?

I'm not saying every new idea is automatically perfect. Every production and casting process should be transparent, professional, and accountable.

But rejecting innovation simply because it challenges traditional practices is not how industries grow.

We cannot keep telling actors to think outside the box while demanding that everyone in the industry stay inside it.

The future belongs to the people willing to build something different.

If you're an actor, why wouldn't you want another legitimate opportunity to demonstrate your talent?

If you're a filmmaker, why wouldn't you want to discover talent beyond your existing network?

And if you're a casting professional, why wouldn't you at least be willing to explore a new model?

Let's stop confusing tradition with progress.

🎥 ACTORS: THIS IS YOUR INVITATION.

Gratwick is looking for its next Sasha and Jeremy.

Here's how to submit:

1. Record an unedited 1–2 minute video on your favorite social media platform.

2. Tell the world what acting means to you, how you got started, and when you knew this was your passion.

3. Tag Gratwick:

   Instagram: @GratwickEnterprises

   TikTok: @Gratwick

   X: @GratwickEnt

4. Complete the submission form at:

👉 https://casting.gratwick.io

Read the participation terms, understand the process, and bring your talent.

No guarantee of casting. No promises of instant stardom. Just another door worth considering.

THE QUESTION ISN'T WHETHER CASTING SHOULD CHANGE.

The question is: WHO IS BRAVE ENOUGH TO CHANGE IT?

👇 ACTORS, FILMMAKERS, CASTING DIRECTORS: I WANT TO HEAR FROM YOU.

Is the traditional casting system due for a major disruption?

#Gratwick #ActorsLife #CastingCall #IndependentFilm #Hollywood

Questions

Text me

Melissa Lavigne 

Casting Director

818-493-0204

**Looking for Film Festival Coordinators**

We are currently inviting motivated and organized individuals to join us as **Film Festival Coordinators** for upcoming festival seasons, including programs connected to the **Canada Kids Film Festival (CKFF)**.

**Role Overview:**

Film Festival Coordinators will support the planning, coordination, and smooth execution of festival activities. This is a great opportunity for those passionate about film, events, and working with creative communities.

**Who We’re Looking For:**

Strong organizational and communication skills

Interest in film festivals and cultural events

Ability to coordinate schedules, teams, and logistics

Reliable, proactive, and professional

Previous event or festival experience is an asset (but not required)

**How to Apply:**

Visit our website to learn more: **[ckff.ca](http://ckff.ca/)**

Complete the official Google Form:

[https://forms.gle/R1ZuJBiz9APdRVjP8

](https://forms.gle/R1ZuJBiz9APdRVjP8)Selected applicants will be contacted with next steps.

Join us in creating meaningful film experiences and supporting emerging talent.

SPIS POSTACI:
Role główne:
ZEGARMISTRZ - energiczny, przebojowy, to on sprawuje pieczę nad miastem i dziejącymi się w nim wydarzeniami. Skrywa w sobie tajemnicę. Mężczyzna w wieku 16 - 35 lat. Wymagana umiejętność śpiewu. Mile widziane doświadczenie taneczne. 

HUGO - młody, ambitny, zabiegany, zagubiony. Główny bohater całej historii, próbuje odnaleźć się w pośpiechu świata. Chłopak w wieku 16 - 25? lat. Umiejętność śpiewu wymagana, doświadczenie taneczne mile widziane.

BELLADONNA - stanowcza, silna, władcza. Czarny charakter w miasteczku. Umiejętność śpiewu wymagana, doświadczenie taneczne mile widziane. Kobieta w wieku 16 - 35 lat.

BOB - dobry duch i wsparcie dla każdego w miasteczku. Nikt nie wiem kim do końca jest i z kim się wziął ale zawsze można na niego liczyć w trudnej chwili. Zabawny, wesoły, wyluzowany, pełny światła. Mężczyzna w wieku 16-35 lat.

BABCIA - Babcia Huga, spokojna, dobra, pełna miłości, spokoju, ma najczystsze serce na świecie. Kobieta 16 - 35 lat.

Role drugoplanowe:
Doświadczenie wokalne i taneczne mile widziane. 
WETERYNARZ- Mężczyzna 16 - 25 lat
STEWARD - Mężczyzna 16 - 25 lat
PIELĘGNIARKA- Kobieta 16 - 25 lat
NAUCZYCIELKA - Kobieta 16-25 lat

📅 JAK WYGLĄDA CASTING?
Casting składa się z dwóch etapów:
1. I etap (online) – na podstawie nadesłanych zgłoszeń.
2. II etap (stacjonarny) – odbędzie się w Gdańsku 15.11.

🚨 BARDZO WAŻNE – HARMONOGRAM PRÓB I PREMIERA
Zanim wyślisz zgłoszenie, upewnij się, że możesz wziąć udział w próbach w Trójmieście. Przewidujemy, że praca będzie szła na tyle sprawnie, że zmniejszymy ilość prób i godzin;)) W rozpisce są dwa możliwe terminy setów spektaklowych - jesteśmy w trakcie ustalania szczegółów.

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?
Wyślij maila na adres: przedostatniprzystanek@gmail.com
W tytule umieść:
        1. Imię, nazwisko
        2. napis CASTING
        3. Nazwa postaci, która cię interesuje. (W mailu napisz również czy zgadzasz się na obsadzenie cię w innej postaci.)
przykład: Anna Kowalska, CASTING, Belladonna
W wiadomości umieść:
1. Krótki opis swojej osoby oraz aktualne zdjęcia (portret + sylwetka).
2. Opis dotychczasowego doświadczenia (CV; jeśli masz selftape – koniecznie podlinkuj, bardzo mile widziany! - link do prywatnego filmu na yt😊).
3. Link do swojego profilu na Facebooku / Messengerze. 

⏰ Czas ucieka! Na zgłoszenia czekamy do 12 listopada włącznie.
Do osób zakwalifikowanych do II etapu odezwiemy się drogą mailową.
Czujesz, że to coś dla Ciebie? Nie zwlekaj, zgłoś się i tworzymy coś razem! 🌟
Jeśli twoja osoba różni się od wymaganych opisów - próbuj! Może stworzysz nowe oblicze tej postaci;))

items.text:
Hey filmy, theatrey, comedy, improvy, dancey, musically, artsy, photography, videography, writery, televisiony, industrialy, voice overy, productiony, investory, small businessy, or just curiousy friends!!!

Next Saturday the CFVA (Colorado Film & Video Association) is hosting it’s annual Town Hall event and I HIGHLY encourage you to come. There will be satellite events all over the state, so if you are not in Denver, don’t worry. You are not left out! 

This year we are focusing on creating connections and a more cohesive community. A community for all and we want to hear YOUR voice. We want you to be a big part of the discussion. Your ideas and thoughts matter. So come and share them! 

If you have not been to a Town Hall before, this is a different event than a schmoozer. At the Town Hall, we actually discuss the trajectory of our industry and how to make it better - in large groups and in small break out groups. It’s where we get things done and when intentions get set.

Here are the details. I genuinely hope you attend and help make our community better, stronger and more undeniable! 

RSVP for your region
Saturday, November 14
Join us for the third Film and Media Town Hall now run by the CFVA.

This is the continuation of a series of community-led events aimed to foster statewide collaboration among creatives and media professionals.This state-wide event will take place simultaneously in EIGHT CITIES ACROSS OUR STATE and with an online virtual option for those of you traveling or unable to make one of the locations.

Our goal? To unite our community to grow a strong, thriving film and media industry in Colorado.

The topic? Community Connections - how do we break down the silos

Please RSVP below, so we know how many people will attend each location.

This event is free for everyone to attend thanks to our generous group of volunteers and sponsors: The CFVA, OEDIT CO Office of Film, Television and Media, The City of Lakewood, Mass FX Media, and LoCo+.

RSVP for Your City

[https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc8n42tusi4gHoWKB0KhLsHXC-EoPZfOYgkfNyJXg15zssZdg/viewform](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc8n42tusi4gHoWKB0KhLsHXC-EoPZfOYgkfNyJXg15zssZdg/viewform)

CASTING CALL:
We are looking for 1 older Black female actress who can do a Nigerian accent and 1 young Black actress who presents masc. We are casting for 2 world premiere plays that are written by 2 local playwrights in the Denver metro area. Performances are December 12 & 13. Rehearsals expected to begin in November. 

The Phase: A lesbian couple from two different cultures must slap on happy faces to prove to their traditional mothers that their gay love is not just a phase. {Casting for an older Black actress to do a Nigerian accent.}

We Need to Talk: A Lesbian Fever Dream: Newly almost u-hauling lesbians Mina and Blessing have some things to talk about before they move in. But they are so blinded by the intensity that they don’t stop to question if it’s really love. Mina falls into a fever dream that helps her work through what’s blocking their communication. {Casting for a young Black actress to present masc}.

At this time this is unpaid, but we aspire to provide compensation if profit has been made from ticket sales. Please fill out this this form: https://forms.gle/PntywLtLWTjmP1JX8 or email moodytingsllc@gmail.com to be considered. Thank you!

CASTING CALL FOR AUDIO DRAMA 

TITLE: The Haunted Man: A Charles Dickens Christmas Story

GENRE: Drama

LOGLINE: A professor of chemistry at a school in 19th century England is haunted by a phantom and the memories of his past leading him to infect those around him with his curse and learn his own valuable lesson about forgiveness and compassion. 

ROLES: (American or British Accents)

Open Casting call for the Treasure Coast Renaissance Festival!

For those interested in joining our vibrant cast!
If you have a passion for the Renaissance era, we want to see your talent.

Audition Details:
Dates: Saturday, November 14th. and Sunday, November 15th, 2026
Location:  The Treasure Coast Renaissance Festival
750 154th Ave. Vero Beach, FL 32066
Time: 10am to 5pm (both days)

This is an open casting call, and as such, scheduling an audition is not necessary, (though, scheduling an appointment is fine as well. 
Email ophelia@treasurecoastrenaissancefestival.com to schedule an interview.)

OR Just show up on an audition date at the indicated above time, and you will be seen.
No experience needed. We will train.

Contact:
Please email Ophelia@treasurecoastrenaissancefestival.com for any questions.
Join us for a season of new beginnings and wondrous opportunities. All levels of experience are encouraged to audition for our local cast, and training is provided!

We are primarily casting roles for those who are 18+, but exceptions may be made for younger actors who show maturity and promise along with written parental permission or on-site supervision.
Local cast members receive a daily stipend for performance days to offset the cost of food, transportation, and costumes.
Auditions will comprise of meeting the directors, discussing your talents and interests to determine where you may best fit, a reading (you can either prepare a one-minute monologue or a monologue or scene with a director will be provided to you to read from), and a discussion of expectations for local cast participation. Should you be interested in Stage Combat, a brief movement audition will also be given.
***Support Squad***
Don’t want to perform but want to participate behind the scenes? We’re also looking for Stage Managers, Costumers, Prop Builders, and anyone wanting to support our cast. For example, you may not have a trade skill, but we always need people to host the green room, go on supply runs, help manage cast schedules, etc.
***Professional Actors, Read Here!***
Are you a professional actor looking for a paid role? If so, email your headshot, resume, and reel (if you have one) to the casting director for consideration. Qualified actors are expected to have a minimum of two years of professional acting experience, proficiency in Elizabethan Dialect, and possess one or more of the following skills: SAFD Trained Stage Combatant, Dance, Singing, Movement, Shakespearian Theatre, Stage Acting, High-Level Long Form Improv Theatre, or a Musical Instrument. If you meet these requirements, the directors will reach out to you with salary expectations and plan an in-person or online audition. This audition will consist of a dramatic monologue, comedic monologue, improv audition, and acapella song. This is a non-union role. Actors must be available for all performance dates and specific rehearsals. Stage Combatants must submit a video of at least one full fight. Rehearsals are unpaid, and we will contract and pay you every two weeks of the run of the fair.
***In Closing***
Any further questions? Contact the casting director:
Ophelia@treasurecoastrenaissancefestival.com 
We can’t wait to see you!

**CASTING CALL: THE LURE**
Independent short film | Long Island, NY

Casting three roles for a psychological thriller about a predator who believes he has complete control—until the people he has harmed turn the tables. Performers must be comfortable with intense dramatic material.

**VERA CAIN — Female, 25–35 | Lead**
Intelligent, composed, and dangerous. Vera lures men by letting them underestimate her. She first appears vulnerable, then reveals calm authority and controlled menace. Seeking an actor with strong emotional control who can make the shift through stillness, eye contact, and intense whispered dialogue. The role includes staged restraint and choreographed, non-contact prop-weapon imagery.

**ELENA CROSS — Female, 20–30 | Supporting | No dialogue**
A survivor who arrives at Victor’s home on a mission. Elena communicates through facial expression, movement, and stillness. She has a healed scar across her neck and reveals two long prop knives concealed in her sleeves. Seeking an actor who can convey survival, grief, resolve, and controlled fury without dialogue. The role includes realistic scar makeup and choreographed, non-contact prop-knife imagery.

**Self-tape:** Submit two short, silent moments: Elena in a parked car at night, focused on the house she has come to; then entering an unseen room, facing someone who recognizes her, and slowly lowering her hands as if revealing something concealed. **No knives or props needed.**

**VICTOR HENSFIELD — Male, 45–60 | Lead**
Polished, professional, and used to being in control. Victor is quiet, watchful, and intimidating without shouting. When Vera and Elena take control away from him, his composure fractures into genuine fear. Seeking an actor who can play authority, menace, and entitlement, then shift believably into panic. The role includes intense whispered dialogue, staged restraint, and non-contact staged violence.

**Self-tape:** Submit two short scenes: Victor speaking calmly to someone he believes is afraid of him; then realizing that person is no longer afraid and struggling to maintain control as fear takes over.

**Content notice:** Mature psychological-thriller themes, including the implied history of sexual violence. **No nudity, sexual activity, or sexual violence is depicted on screen.**

**Location:** Long Island, NY
**Shoot dates:** TBD
**Compensation:** To be discussed
**Union status:** NON-UNION & UNION
**To submit:** Headshot, résumé, reel if available, and the self-tape for the role(s) you’re interested in.
**Contact:** guillermopabon@nycfilmsproductions.com

Seeking EXTRAs and a Hindu priest for a South Asian Short Film in NOVA
1. We are seeking South Asian Extras to participate in our short film.

- South Asian adult (male or female) available Friday, November 13th 8am-3pm in Reston, VA or Sunday, November 15th 5-8pm in Ashburn, VA.

 - We are also looking for someone to play the role of a South Asian mother available Thursday, November 12th 8am-2pm and Saturday 8am-2pm

2. The production is also looking for a Hindu priest (or someone knowledgeable about Hindu religious practices and rituals) to appear in a brief scene involving a ceremony honoring a deceased family member on Friday, November 13, 2026, so availability on this date is required.

No prior acting experience is necessary! 

We're primarily looking for someone who can help ensure the scene is portrayed authentically and respectfully.

If you or someone you know is available and interested, please reach out.

Meals will be provided! Please email treelineproductions1204@gmail.com

———————————

About the Film
The Ideal is a short family drama about two South Asian American brothers who reunite
following the death of their mother. One brother left home to pursue professional success, while
the other stayed behind and became their mother's primary caregiver. Over the course of their
reunion, years of unspoken resentment surrounding family, sacrifice, and success begin to
surface.

LA / SOCAL ACTORS & CREATORS — BUILD AN AUDIENCE THAT COMES BACK FOR YOU

Turn your on-camera skills into your own LIVE show. Build an audience around your personality and explore an additional income stream alongside acting.

I'm David, connecting LA / Southern California actors, models, hosts and creators with the Lion King team to explore TikTok LIVE.

WHAT YOU GET

• Free training in livestreaming and content development

• Livestream operations, account and backend support

• Performance analytics and equipment-setup guidance

• A chance to develop your own hosting style and direct audience relationships

Bring your personality, performance skills and willingness to learn. TikTok profiles are preferred; Instagram and reels are welcome. Interested in streaming from home or fitting LIVE around creative work? Tell us so we can discuss a feasible arrangement.

The agency is compensated separately by TikTok and does not deduct an agency commission from creators' withdrawable earnings. Platform fees, eligibility and payout rules still apply. Earnings vary and are not guaranteed. This is a creator-network opportunity, not a salaried acting job. Training dates, selection, time commitments and contract terms will be discussed before participation. No official TikTok sponsorship or TikTok-led training is claimed in this notice.

Email shilianghaozhi@gmail.com or DM David Shi with your TikTok/Instagram link, reel, city, languages, availability and any LIVE experience. We'll review profiles and arrange introductory conversations.

items.text:
My son has been asking to model
I have been skeptical about letting him model but hearing that he should or asking if he does model has made him basically beg me to let him try. We went around our neighborhood and just took a bunch of photos on my phone. He is an athlete, very energetic and incredibly teachable, kind and focused. 

I have no clue where to start and now that football season is over I told him that I will look into it. 

Any help or suggestions would be greatly appreciated:)💜

* he really wanted me to show yall his sports photos and he Zoolander and Jim Carey impressions - the last two! hahaha*

🎭 𝐄𝐗𝐏𝐄𝐑𝐈𝐄𝐍𝐂𝐄 𝐀 𝐇𝐈𝐆𝐇𝐄𝐑 𝐒𝐓𝐀𝐍𝐃𝐀𝐑𝐃 𝐎𝐅 𝐀𝐂𝐓𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐓𝐑𝐀𝐈𝐍𝐈𝐍𝐆 🎭

𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐀𝐜𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐲 | Auditions Now Open in Swinton, Manchester

If you have a deep passion for acting and are committed to building a sustainable career in the performing arts, you have found your training ground. Welcome to Marble Academy, where you turn “𝑰’𝒅 𝒍𝒐𝒗𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝒂𝒄𝒕” 𝒊𝒏𝒕𝒐 “𝑰’𝒎 𝒃𝒖𝒊𝒍𝒅𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝒂 𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒍 𝒄𝒂𝒓𝒆𝒆𝒓.”🏆

𝐖𝐇𝐘 𝐌𝐀𝐑𝐁𝐋𝐄 𝐀𝐂𝐀𝐃𝐄𝐌𝐘? 

* Spotlight-accredited & multi-award-winning (including consecutive ‘𝐁𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐃𝐫𝐚𝐦𝐚 𝐒𝐜𝐡𝐨𝐨𝐥 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐘𝐞𝐚𝐫’ wins) 

* Our actors land roles in award-winning films & professional productions 

* Direct, honest feedback—no empty praise, just real industry results 

* Led directly by Christian Le Feuvre (LAMDA-qualified actor & award-winning filmmaker)

🎬 𝐂𝐎𝐌𝐏𝐑𝐄𝐇𝐄𝐍𝐒𝐈𝐕𝐄 𝐓𝐑𝐀𝐈𝐍𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐈𝐍𝐂𝐋𝐔𝐃𝐄𝐒: 

✨ Script Analysis & Characterisation 

🎥 Acting for Camera & Screen Technique 

🎭 Audition Preparation & Room Confidence 

...plus an extensive suite of additional modules covering the complete craft.

📅 𝐂𝐋𝐀𝐒𝐒 𝐃𝐄𝐓𝐀𝐈𝐋𝐒: 

⏰ 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧: Mondays, 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM 

📍 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞: Swinton, Manchester

👉 Tap the link in our bio to read student testimonials & book your audition slot today! 🔗 www.marbleacademy.co.uk

“𝐃𝐨𝐧’𝐭 𝐛𝐞 𝐚𝐧 𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐨𝐫 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐭𝐨; 𝐛𝐞 𝐚𝐧 𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐨𝐫 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐇𝐀𝐕𝐄 𝐭𝐨!”

#ManchesterActors #ActingClassesManchester #ActingSchool #UKActors

items.text:
***‘Learning clowning with DeCastro busted open my creative practice and my heart. We laughed, we cried, we were silly, we became responsive and original in our environment. By practising putting our everyday selves on the shelf for a while, we learned to follow a deeper set of ideas and be more fully human. When de Castro teaches clowning, you become a part of their 40-year-long love affair with the craft.’***  2017 participant – writer and producer.

**The Why Not Winter Clown School 2027**

**Enrolments are now open!**

𝟰𝘁𝗵 𝘁𝗼 𝟮𝟯𝗿𝗱 𝗝𝗮𝗻𝘂𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟳 | 𝗟𝗼𝗻𝗱𝗼𝗻 - 𝗨𝗞

‘𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗧𝗼 𝗕𝗲 𝗔 𝗦𝘁𝘂𝗽𝗶𝗱’

Mon 4th to Fri 15th Jan 27 | 9am - 6pm

‘𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗧𝗼 𝗕𝗲 𝗘𝘃𝗲𝗻 𝗠𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗢𝗳 𝗔 𝗦𝘁𝘂𝗽𝗶𝗱’

Mon 18th to Sat 23rd Jan 27 | 9am to 5pm

‘𝗔𝗹𝗹 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗡𝗲𝗲𝗱 𝗜𝘀 𝗟𝗮𝘂𝗴𝗵’

Sat 9th Jan 27 | 10.30am to 11.30am

‘𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗣𝗹𝗲𝗮𝘀𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗢𝗳 𝗣𝗹𝗮𝘆𝗶𝗻𝗴’

Sat 9th Jan 27 | 1 pm to 5 pm

** **

**For an application form & more info, please email: 𝘄𝗵𝘆𝗻𝗼𝘁𝗶𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗶𝘁𝘂𝘁𝗲@𝗮𝗼𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺**

**Full details on all workshops: **https://thewhynotinstitute.com/when-are-the-courses/

**Get in touch - we’ll love to hear from you!**

Do kolejnego listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do następujących ról:

1.Bocian (35) – postawny, łysy, tatuaże, agresywny, porywczy, typ gangusa  - prawo jazdy
Data: 11 i 12. listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

2.Artur (27) – pracownik lakierni samochodowej. Dobrze zbudowany, postawny, krótkie włosy. Konkretny, chętnie rozmawia z policją.
Data: 11 listopada
Stawka: 600 zł netto

3.Stróż (60) – stróż pracujący na złomowisku. Ciekawski, interesuje się wszystkim dookoła. 
Data: 12 listopada
Stawka: 400 zł netto

4.Gangster 3 (41) – Gangster zatrzymany na złomowisku. Wysoki, chudy, tatuaże. Na początku nie chce pracować z policją, ale dociśnięty sypie wszystkich współpracowników.
Data: 12 i 13 listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

Chętnych aktorów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania
9. Data lub odcinek grania w pierwszym sezonie Gliniarzy Śląsk

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

🎬 **CASTING – NAUCZYCIELKA (ROLA MÓWIONA)**

📅 **DATA: 5.11 (CZWARTEK) – GODZINY POPOŁUDNIOWE**

📍 **LOKALIZACJA: WARSZAWA, GROCHÓW**

💰 **STAWKA: 250 ZŁ**

Do odcinka serialu internetowego poszukujemy aktorki do roli nauczycielki geografii.

**Rola obejmuje jedną krótką scenę w sali lekcyjnej.**

**Wymagania:**
* Wiek ekranowy: 35–55 lat
* Mile widziane doświadczenie aktorskie
* dostępność na terenie Warszawy (nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu)

**Zgłoszenia prosimy przesyłać w wiadomości prywatnej, dołączając:**
* Imię i nazwisko
* Wiek
* Aktualne zdjęcia
* **Demo aktorskie lub próbki dotychczasowych występów.** W przypadku braku takich materiałów prosimy o nagranie krótkiej, autorskiej scenki w roli nauczycielki prowadzącej lekcję (np. próbującej zapanować nad niesforną klasą).

❗ **Prosimy o przesyłanie materiałów aktorskich od razu ze zgłoszeniem. Zgłoszenia bez nagrań nie będą rozpatrywane.**

Zastrzegamy sobie kontakt wyłącznie z wybranymi kandydatkami.

items.text:
Hi all! I just wanted to introduce myself and share information about a forthcoming production.
A Game Of Two Halves is a brand new , two act play set in Glasgow. Each act will be approximately 45 minutes. It is written by Michael Lewis.

It tells not just the story of two families on each side of the football divide, but focusses on actual events, five years apart, only one of which has been well documented.

The Hampden riots of 1980 were very well publicised and set legal precedents which we still live with today.

However, the Janefield Street incident of 1985 is much lesser known, but could have been Glasgow's "Hillsborough".

The play is set in the tumult of 1980's Glasgow, amid massive social and political upheaval, where each of the families-  and their communities-  struggle to come to terms with the changes, and make choices that will determine their futures.

Each act is mirror for the other , while  the devastating impact of the incidents on the families is gradually revealed.

The 1980's soundtrack underpins the story and helps to set the scene.

A Game of Two Halves -stylistically and thematically - is not a typical Glasgow play about football and rivalry; it eschews the usual tired and cringe-worthy cliches.

Like Glasgow itself,  A Game of Two halves exudes wit, grit and authenticity.  

It is unpaid.

**ŚLĄSK...ZAGŁĘBIE...OKOLICE**

Na plan serialu Gliniarze Śląsk szukam:

**Dariusz Orlik (37) - **Niedawno zwolniony z więzienia po wyroku za przestępstwa seksualne. Nachalny wobec kobiet, fotografuje je z ukrycia. Podczas przesłuchania na przemian przestraszony i arogancki. 

**nagranie 27.11**

**stawka 700 zł**

**Marek Rosiak (58) - **Właściciel osiedlowego sklepu, ojciec Kamila. Rzeczowy, dobrze mówi o Martynie. Poruszony wiadomością o napaści, a następnie zaskoczony ucieczką syna przed policji

**prawo jazdy**

**nagranie 26.11**

**stawka 800 zł**

**Kamil Rosiak (32) - **syn właściciela sklepu. Sprawca napaści na Martynę. Na widok policji ucieka; podczas przesłuchania załamany, płacze i przyznaje się do czynu. Wymagana sprawność do krótkiego pościgu i zatrzymania. 

**nagranie 26 i 27.11**

**stawka 800 z za dzień**

**Łukasz Zatorski (21) - **Kolega Martyny ze studiów. Nie przyjmuje odmowy, śledzi ją i zbiera jej zdjęcia. Początkowo spokojny, kłamie o alibi; nagle ucieka. Po zatrzymaniu nerwowy i defensywny. Wymagana sprawność do krótkiej ucieczki i obalenia. 

**nagranie 23.11**

**stawka 800 zł**

**Matka Łukasza (45) - **Zwyczajna, zatroskana matka. Nieświadoma zachowania syna, odruchowo podważa jego alibi. Coraz bardziej zaskoczona, podczas jego ucieczki wpada w panikę. 

**nagranie 23.11**

**stawka 600 zł 1 scena**

**Komendant miejski (54) - **Doświadczony oficer, służbowy rozmówca Rychlika i Działaka. Rzeczowy, swobodny wobec Rychlika, mówi o organizacji zatrzymań i sytuacji innych jednostek. 

**nagranie 27.11**

**stawka 500 zł 1 scena**

**Grafik (35) - **Policyjny specjalista od portretów pamięciowych. Spokojny, cierpliwy i delikatny wobec pokrzywdzonej; 

**nagranie 24.11**

**stawka 400 zł 1 scena**

Zainteresowane osoby proszę o zgłoszenie na adres email **obsadaolga@gmail.com**

Zgłoszenie musi zawierać imię, nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, aktualne zdjęcie, demo lub link do wizytówki.

W tytule proszę wpisać wybraną postać.
